subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ25 across its X-Type X400 application.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ25 appears exclusively in the X-Type — a single-application engine, which makes it straightforward to confirm compatibility once your registration is entered.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets and seals, timing chain components where required, and the oil filter housing gasket as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported catastrophic issue pattern has been confirmed for the AJ25 petrol V6. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ25 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ25 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ25 uses timing chains rather than a belt, which means interval-based belt replacement isn't a concern — but the tensioners and guides are inspected as part of every rebuild to confirm they're within specification. As a Ford-derived Duratec V6, the AJ25 shares its basic architecture with the larger AJ30, meaning our workshop procedures are well-established across both displacements.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets and seals, timing chain components where required, oil filter housing gasket

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
